label: Slate
description: Cool greys, soft corners and a teal accent. The conventional business deck, done carefully: structured, legible and quiet.
guidance: The safe choice for a client or board audience, and the most tolerant of dense slides. Use Grid and Rows freely, put numbers in Stat, and close a slide with Note where a caveat belongs. This is the only shipped style with rounded corners, so cards may sit on the panel background rather than needing a border.
